benchmark_observe_interface_options: benchmark observation times using different interface options like raw, feature layer, or rgb configurations
run_benchmark_with_replay: run the benchmark on a specific replay file to measure observation latency across multiple interface configs
run_benchmark_with_map: run the benchmark on a specific map like Catalyst with configurable step multiplier and observation count
build_interface_options_features: build interface options with feature layer resolution and crop settings for SC2 observation benchmarking
build_interface_options_rgb: build interface options with rgb render resolution for SC2 observation benchmarking
